tool.title: Moorksz Visory Media Downloader
tool.summary: Back up the cloud recordings your own Visory account can access to a local folder, with resumable background transfers, exact reports and a verified ZIP.
tool.catalogDescription: Keep your Visory cloud recordings on your own disk without babysitting a browser. Sign in once inside this Windows desktop hub, let it collect the recordings the official web app shows you, and review the count before anything downloads. Backups continue quietly in the background with resumable transfers, verified files, exact reports and an optional verified ZIP. An unofficial development preview: real-account discovery is still unverified.
tool.description: An unofficial Windows desktop hub for backing up cloud recordings accessible from your own Visory account. You sign in through the official Visory web app inside an embedded Microsoft Edge WebView2 window; the hub reads only the recording metadata that app loads, shows the discovered count and scan completeness before downloading, then transfers with Windows BITS or resumable streaming downloads, verifies every file and writes exact logs, CSV reports and an optional ZIP. This page explains the desktop tool; it cannot sign in to Visory or download recordings.

howItWorks.title: Sign in
howItWorks.text: Open the official Visory web app inside the hub. Your password goes only to Visory; the session stays in your Windows profile, protected by Windows encryption.

howItWorks.title: Scan
howItWorks.text: Open each camera's cloud recordings, scroll or use Auto-scroll, then finish the scan. Only metadata from Visory and its own Firebase project is read; media bodies are never inspected.

howItWorks.title: Review
howItWorks.text: Check discovered recordings, cameras, already verified, missing and corrupt files, estimated size and free space. Without proof of completeness, the hub says discovered recordings and warns instead of claiming everything was found.

howItWorks.title: Back up
howItWorks.text: Start the backup and minimize or close the window; it continues in the notification area with pause, resume and safe exit.

howItWorks.title: Verify
howItWorks.text: Each file is size-checked and hashed with SHA-256 before an atomic rename. A changed file is preserved and downloaded again in a later run, never overwritten.

howItWorks.title: Archive and report
howItWorks.text: Read timestamped Markdown logs and error logs plus CSV reports embedded in HTML and Markdown, and optionally keep a verified ZIP64 archive. RUN.cmd captures terminal output from startup onward.

features.title: Honest discovery
features.text: Passive observation of Firebase Storage listings and metadata, Realtime Database frames, Firestore documents and media the app plays. Unknown dates stay eligible, with their provenance labeled.

features.title: Reliable transfer
features.text: Windows BITS for compatible links, otherwise streaming downloads with validated Range resume, Retry-After, jittered retries, authorization refresh, network waits and a disk-space pause.

features.title: Integrity & state
features.text: SQLite state shipped with Windows, one final result per file per run, restart reconciliation, collision-free names and server MD5 checks when available.

features.title: Reports & archives
features.text: Per-line flushed, timestamped Markdown logs/error logs; Excel-safe CSV reports with HTML and Markdown views; redacted credentials/URLs and streaming ZIP64 archives verified by re-reading.

features.title: Privacy & background
features.text: Local-first: no telemetry, uploads or plaintext passwords. Tokens stay in memory, stored links are encrypted with Windows DPAPI, and sign-out deletes the embedded browser profile.

limitations: Unofficial and not affiliated with Visory. Visory publishes no recordings API, so discovery depends on what its web app loads; completeness is reported as not confirmable at best.

Real Visory sign-in, discovery, downloads, link renewal, scheduled scans and BITS continuation after exit were not tested with an account. Automated tests use a loopback server, a mock provider and a clearly labeled demo mode.

Unreleased development preview without a signed EXE or installer. Unsigned builds may be blocked by SmartScreen, Smart App Control or WDAC; on the development machine Application Control blocked several local builds.

Requires Windows 10/11 x64 and the Microsoft Edge WebView2 Runtime for sign-in, which is not bundled. Direct downloads stop when the app exits and resume on the next start; BITS is used only for compatible links without sign-in headers.
useCases: Keep an independent local copy of the cloud recordings your account can access.
Back up only new or missing recordings on a schedule after the first full run.
Resume a large backup after a network outage, sleep or restart.
Prove which recordings were saved, skipped or failed with exact reports.
Hand off one verified ZIP archive with a manifest of every recording in scope.

setup.title: Check Windows prerequisites
setup.text: Windows 10/11 x64 with the Microsoft Edge WebView2 Runtime, which is preinstalled on Windows 11. The portable EXE bundles .NET; building from source requires the .NET 10 SDK. Nothing is installed by visiting this page.

setup.title: Start with terminal diagnostics
setup.text: No public executable release exists yet. From tools/visory-media-downloader, RUN.cmd begins logging before prerequisites, incremental build and app launch. Requires the .NET 10 SDK. Use RUN.cmd -CheckOnly for checks without launching the app; missing native prerequisites are reported, not installed. The generated local report.html groups daily results and links to exact Markdown log lines.

setup.title: Try demo mode first
setup.text: Demo mode generates clearly labeled synthetic recordings in a separate folder to show scanning, backup, reports and archives without a Visory account.

setup.title: Sign in, scan and review
setup.text: Choose Sign in & scan, open your cloud recordings in Visory and finish the scan. Review the inventory and warnings, then start the backup. Back up a small date range first to confirm results with your account.

setup.title: Find files and reports
setup.text: Recordings, archives and per-run reports live in the chosen backup folder (default Videos\Visory Backup). Settings stay beside the EXE when its folder is writable; the sign-in session always stays in your Windows profile.

tool.downloadNotice: Not yet released. There is no public EXE, installer or signed build. Downloads in the Tool section are text source, not an executable release; a local build is not a published release. Nothing is installed, launched or connected by opening this page.
